periods.label: Mon 23 Nov
periods.text: Northerly 15 to 25 knots shifting southerly in the evening. Squalls possible with the wind change. Around 1 metre, increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres offshore. Northeasterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres. Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm during the morning and afternoon, with possible squalls during this afternoon and early evening.
